name: ip-toolkit
title: IP Toolkit
description: Public and local IPs, gateway, DNS and Wi-Fi, IP change history, WHOIS, subnet calculator, port scan, speed test and quick public tunnels.
author: veilwalker

commands.name: show-my-ip
commands.title: Show My IP
commands.subtitle: IP Toolkit
commands.description: List your public IP and the local addresses of every network interface, with copy and paste actions

preferences.name: showIPv6
preferences.title: Public IPv6
preferences.label: Also look up the public IPv6 address
preferences.description: Query the public IPv6 address in addition to IPv4. Keep it off on networks without IPv6 so the list opens faster

commands.name: copy-my-ip
commands.title: Copy My IP
commands.subtitle: IP Toolkit
commands.description: Copy your external or internal IP to the clipboard without opening a view

commands.name: paste-my-ip
commands.title: Paste My IP
commands.subtitle: IP Toolkit
commands.description: Paste your external or internal IP at the cursor of the frontmost app; it also stays in the clipboard

commands.name: monitor-public-ip
commands.title: Monitor Public IP
commands.subtitle: IP Toolkit
commands.description: Check the public IP every 5 minutes in the background, show it under the command name and notify when it changes

commands.name: public-ip-history
commands.title: Public IP History
commands.subtitle: IP Toolkit
commands.description: List every public IP recorded by Monitor Public IP, with when each one was seen

commands.name: whois-lookup
commands.title: Whois Lookup
commands.subtitle: IP Toolkit
commands.description: Look up the owner, network range and abuse contact of an IP, domain or ASN through RDAP

commands.name: subnet-calculator
commands.title: Subnet Calculator
commands.subtitle: IP Toolkit
commands.description: Calculate network, broadcast, host range and host count for an IPv4 or IPv6 CIDR

commands.name: port-scan
commands.title: Port Scan
commands.subtitle: IP Toolkit
commands.description: Check which TCP ports are open on a host you own or are authorized to test

commands.name: speed-test
commands.title: Speed Test
commands.subtitle: IP Toolkit
commands.description: Measure latency, download and upload speed using Cloudflare's speed test servers

commands.name: manage-tunnels
commands.title: Manage Tunnels
commands.subtitle: IP Toolkit
commands.description: See running cloudflared and ngrok tunnels and expose a local port with a temporary public URL

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
